intro: São Tomé and Príncipe is a semi-presidential democracy.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years, and the prime minister leads the government. Príncipe has its own regional government.

chapters.title: Peaceful change
text: Opposition parties have won power through elections several times.

keyTerms.meaning: Both a president and a prime minister.

cardGroups.title: How power works
cardGroups.intro: Who chooses whom, and what each part of the system does.

steps.title: How a law is made
steps.intro: Most new laws follow these steps.
